metadatos.descripcion: Personal finance without spreadsheets: log expenses over WhatsApp and see your free margin and per-category budgets.
metadatos.altImagen: Mango logo with the line “Your finances, one message away”

inicio.descripcion: Mango sorts out your month: spending, income, savings and what you have left.
inicio.heroTexto: Mango sorts out your month, with fixed costs, budgets and savings, and tells you how much is still free. No spreadsheets.
inicio.historiaPaso0: This is your month in Mango.
inicio.historiaPaso1: Text it like you'd text a friend.
inicio.historiaPaso2: It understands and files it for you.
inicio.historiaPaso3: And your free margin updates instantly.
inicio.historiaDescripcion: Preview of the Mango dashboard with sample data. Three WhatsApp messages log expenses and the free margin drops from €864 to €783.20.

historiaMensajes.respuesta: Logged ✅ Taxi · €12.50 in Transport. You've spent €85 of €100 this month 🟡

inicio.escribeTexto: The amount and what it was for. Mango does the rest: the category, the day, and whether it was a fixed cost it was expecting.
inicio.ritmoTitulo: See the pace before you overspend.
inicio.ritmoTexto: Every budgeted category tells you how much you have left per week. You find out on day 10, not when the statement arrives.
inicio.ritmoGrafico: Food spending over the month, in euros
inicio.ritmoGraficoDescripcion: €400 budget. Day 5: 160; day 10: 310; day 15: 380; day 20: 440; day 25: 490; day 30: 530. On day 10 Mango already shows €37 left per week, twenty days before the month ends.
inicio.funcionesTitulo: Your whole month, on one screen.
inicio.margenTexto: What you have left after fixed costs and budgets. One number, always up to date.
inicio.fijosTexto: Rent, the gym or a loan in installments: Mango adds them every month on its own and shows you what's coming up.
inicio.proyeccionTexto: See how the coming months look with your fixed costs and budgets, and plan today.
inicio.presupuestoTexto: Cap food or going out and see how much you have left per week.

faq.pregunta: Does Mango connect to my bank?
faq.respuesta: No. You log what you spend, on WhatsApp or on the web. Mango never asks for bank credentials or sees your accounts.
No one. A language model reads each message to pull out the amount and the category, and the expense lands in your account. Only you can see it.
No. You can log and edit everything on the web. WhatsApp is the quick way to jot things down on the go.
Nothing. Mango is free; if a paid plan ever comes, you'll hear about it first.

faq.pregunta: Does it work in my country?
faq.respuesta: Yes. Mango is in Spanish and English and works from anywhere. Amounts are shown in euros or Argentine pesos for now; more currencies are on the way.

privacidad.intro: Mango stores the minimum it needs to work and never sells or shares your data for advertising.

secciones.texto: Your e-mail, so you can sign in. If you link WhatsApp, your phone number. And what you log: expenses, income, savings, categories, budgets and fixed costs.

When you text the bot, the message is sent to a language model (Google's Gemini, on a paid account whose content Google does not use for training) to extract the amount, the description and the category. Mango stores the resulting entry. The message text is not kept, except on accounts with conversation history enabled, where it is kept for 30 days so the bot remembers recent context.
Mango does not connect to your bank or ask for credentials. It only knows what you log.

The database runs on Supabase and the website on Vercel. Sign-in codes are sent through Resend and WhatsApp messages go through Meta's official API. None of them receive your data for anything other than providing that service.
Only the necessary ones: your session and the one that remembers your language. No advertising or tracking cookies.
You can ask for a copy of your data or have your account deleted with everything in it. Write to {correo} and it is done within a few days.
